specs.title: Agent guardrails
specs.why: An agent with booking and payment tools on a public channel is an attack surface.
specs.scope: Defences against prompt injection, cross-tenant calls, abuse and runaway usage, with human handoff.
tasks: Add `app/lib/agent/runtime.ts`: assert tenant scope before every tool call
Add `app/lib/agent/handoff.ts`: hand off to a human on repeated failure
acceptance: Every case in `__tests__/agent-redteam.test.ts` is blocked, verified by `pnpm test`
The handoff command halts the agent and alerts the owner
scope_paths: `__tests__/**` and `tests/**` for the tests that prove the criteria
`prisma/schema.prisma` and `prisma/migrations/**` when the work needs schema support
`docs/**` for documentation the change makes stale

specs.title: Booking link and QR generation
specs.why: Merchants convert walk-in traffic by displaying a scannable link in the shop.
specs.scope: Generate a branded booking URL and a downloadable QR image and PDF.
acceptance: The generated code resolves to `/{slug}`, verified by `pnpm test`
`app/api/qr/[slug]/route.ts` returns HTTP 200 with a PDF body
The owner receives the file over WhatsApp after setup
scope_paths: `__tests__/**` and `tests/**` for the tests that prove the criteria
`prisma/schema.prisma` and `prisma/migrations/**` when the work needs schema support
`docs/**` for documentation the change makes stale
